items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Binge got the idea of taking the show and, and building this band with, uh, with Lee Collins and David Jones as the leader of it... So, um, we worked there.

ctx.x: You missed out the, uh, the Lee Collins period there. Well, I, well, that, oh, yeah, that's right,

that's right. That was, that was before Sidney Desmond, I mean Sidney Desmond, because there was, there was a fella named John Morell, banjo player. He had a job at the La Vida, as a jitney dance. That's right. And, um, and that band was, the leader was John Morell, the banjo player, and, uh, Lee Collins on trumpet. Thereto Poinnell on alto and David Jones on tenor. Yeah. Uh, Joe Rovershaw on piano, uh, and, uh, Albert Martin, I think, the drummer. Oh, Albert Martin. Yeah. On drum, and I took John Morell's play.…
